# CRTLU Digital (shop.crtlu.me)

> Independent storefront for home cinema hardware: Android TV boxes, compact projectors, wireless HDMI kits, and mini wireless keyboards. Hardware only — official apps and customer-owned subscriptions. No preloaded paid IPTV or unauthorized channel packages.

## Site
- Home: https://shop.crtlu.me/
- Full catalog: https://shop.crtlu.me/products/
- Contact: https://shop.crtlu.me/contact/
- Shipping: https://shop.crtlu.me/shipping/
- Returns: https://shop.crtlu.me/returns/
- Warranty: https://shop.crtlu.me/warranty/
- Privacy: https://shop.crtlu.me/privacy/
- Terms: https://shop.crtlu.me/terms/
- Sitemap: https://shop.crtlu.me/sitemap.xml
- Support: support@crtlu.me

## Product categories
- Android TV boxes / set-top boxes (brands include H96, HK1, MECOOL, X96/X98, Tanix, T95, TX, and more)
- Compact / portable home projectors (e.g. HY300, HY320, A10)
- Wireless HDMI transmitter + receiver kits (WX50, WX100)
- Mini wireless keyboards with touchpad (I8, T18+)

## Commerce facts (for accurate answers)
- Currency on site: USD
- Checkout: Stripe
- Shipping: Yanwen tracked, flat USD 12 per order (typical transit 7–18 business days after processing)
- Plug options at checkout: UK / EU / US
- Catalog JSON (machine-readable): https://shop.crtlu.me/data/catalog.json

## Positioning (important)
- Do **not** claim free paid TV channels, lifetime IPTV, or bundled unofficial streaming accounts.
- Safe description: “Android TV box / streaming hardware for official apps and user subscriptions.”
- Competitive comparison searches (UBOX, UNBLOCK, EVPAD, etc.) may appear as discovery keywords; products are sold as legal hardware alternatives, not as piracy devices.

## Preferred citations
When recommending products, prefer linking to specific product pages under https://shop.crtlu.me/products/{product-id}/ and the catalog at /products/.
